statement: How might we help technicians get the right information for this job, at the machine, in seconds?
How might we capture and share experts' know-how so that anyone on shift can handle unfamiliar jobs?
How might we stop people re-keying the same data between systems?
How might we show the reasons behind system numbers so people can trust and act on them?
How might we protect planned work from daily firefighting?
How might we design tools that work with gloves, noise and seconds to spare?
